candidates.change_summary: Remove the reentrancy guard by changing the modifier to omit locking (sets locked_ = true only before body, does not reset it to false afterwards), causing subsequent calls to nonReentrant_ protected functions (like Put) to fail or behave differently.
Change Put to set unlockTime always to the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp), allowing callers to set past unlock times and thus changing stored state.
Change Put to assign the unlockTime to block.timestamp regardless of input, ignoring the provided _unlockTime parameter.
Change Put to not update the holder's balance (remove the balance increment), so stored balance after Put differs.

Replace the external call to msg.sender.call{value: _am}("") with a transfer-style state update first (subtracting balance) before making the external call, changing reentrancy/ordering effects and thus observable Collect behavior.
Remove the external call and instead credit the sender's balance (no ETH sent), altering post-call observable state for Collect.
Change nonReentrant_ modifier to not reset locked_ at end (remove unlocking), causing subsequent Collect calls to revert and thus altering observable Collect behavior.
